summary: Check-Cap Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, attaching a press release about MBody AI Corp., the counterparty to a proposed business combination with Check-Cap. The press release announces MBody AI's expansion into outdoor autonomous cleaning robots, securing exclusive U.S. distribution rights in six states. This is an operational business update, not a special-situation event. The filing references the pending merger but provides no new deal terms, pricing, or strategic changes. Routine disclosure for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation classification applicable.
